name: Candied Apricots
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Soak dried apricots in a large volume of water for around 10 minutes.
Combine the 1 cup water and the sugar, and taste to adjust sweetness.
Bring sugar mixture to a boil and add apricots.
Simmer until the liquid is reduced. The traditional consistency is close to a light syrup.
